title: The record concluded that the activity view is cached per access, although the probe did not cover a backend that connects after the first read
resolution: A second probe shows that a transaction keeps the backends and query texts of its first read and reads wait events live; the records and the barrier comment say so, keep the cause unconfirmed, and no longer claim the only failure path is removed.

title: A failed connection of the holder or the observer left the other client open, outside the cleanup
resolution: connectedPair settles both connection attempts and ends the connected client when the other fails; all five call sites that connect a pair use it, with a fail-before for each failing side.

title: A waiting call that rejected before its lock stayed unhandled while the barrier polled
resolution: waitUntilWaiting handles the call when the barrier starts and fails with its error at the next poll; a fail-before with injected rejections shows no unhandled rejection after the fix.

title: waitForLockWaiters matched any waiting statement that mentions enrollment_tokens, which the new requirement does not allow
resolution: It counts the waiters that the holder blocks, directly or through an earlier waiter, through pg_blocking_pids; the requirement is scoped to barriers a change adds or modifies, and the others are a recorded follow-up.

title: The advisory-lock barrier matched only the low half of the lock key
resolution: waitForWaitingLock also matches classid 0 and objsubid 1; a fail-before with decoy waiters for a two-integer key and a bigint key that share the low half shows they no longer satisfy it.
